_: Literature-based targets for the two basins the best-track tables do not hold (3 South Atlantic tracks, no Mediterranean cyclone): tools/make_tc_synthetic.py turns an entry into <basin>-tc-ref.json and <basin>-tc-maps.json of the same shape as tools/make_tc_basin.py makes from the record. normals: per season, storms that form inside the page (tracks = depressions of 25 kt, named 34 kt, hurricanes the 64-kt count, majors 96 kt); genesis_by_month: the relative number of depressions by calendar month (Jan..Dec); sub_share: the share of them that begin as subtropical (hybrid) cyclones; centers: Gaussian blobs of genesis (degrees, weight); the drift is the page's own mean steering (maps.drift is 'steer'). Every number is approximate; the sources are named in `source`.

satl.label: South Atlantic
satl.source: Brazilian Navy named systems since 2011 (Arani 2011, Bapo and Cari 2015, Deni and Ecai 2016, Iba and Guara 2019, Kurumi 2020, Oquira, Mani and Potira 2021, Raoni 2022, Uba 2024): about one a year, mostly subtropical, 35-55 kt; Catarina (March 2004, category 2, the only hurricane); Gozzo et al. 2014 and Evans and Braun 2012 for the season (October to May, peak January to March) and the place (20-35S, 35-52W, off south-east Brazil); the depressions that never reach 34 kt are not recorded for this basin, so their number is taken as a fifth more than the named storms (the Atlantic's is an eighth)

med.label: Mediterranean
med.source: Medicanes (tropical-like cyclones): Romero and Emanuel 2013 and Cavicchia et al. 2014 (about 1.6 a year in the reanalyses, a third of them with winds of 34 kt or more at some point), Miglietta and Rotunno 2019 (the season September to January, peak October to December; the western basin, the Ionian and the Aegean / Levantine in about 40 / 35 / 25 %); the strong ones: Celeno 1995, Rolf 2011, Zorbas 2018, Ianos 2020 (60-75 kt), Daniel 2023; the depressions that never reach 34 kt are not recorded for this basin, so their number is taken as a fifth more than the named storms (the Atlantic's is an eighth)
